description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Guide Pins for the Oil Seal Housing & Oil Pump.

Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Pins, Oil Seal Housing
Qty 2 – Pins, Oil Pump
What Vehicle Will This Fit?

Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
